unknownCapabilities: Whether ILCE-1M2 has any cinema/log mode properties accessible via PTP3
Whether streaming capability (SDIO_GetStreamSettingList) is fully functional
notes: ILCE-1M2 (Alpha 1 II) is Sony's top-of-line full-frame hybrid camera. Added to PTP3 in v1.3.0 (Jun 2025). Specifically noted in v1.3.1 changelog: SDIO_UploadPartialData, Maximum Size of Image ID String, Shooting Enable Setting (License) enabled. Has pixel shift (Pixel Shift Multi Shooting). No built-in ND filter, no T-Number, no shutter angle — these are cinema-only properties. Dual CFexpress Type A / SD slots. Has FTP transfer and streaming. No timecode in standard Alpha mode (not confirmed as PTP3 timecode property). 2 audio channels (3.5mm).
